identity.name: MoatBot
identity.description: Autonomous Operations Platform for Multi-Agent Systems

usage_rules.gradients: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
usage_rules.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-background/80 for sticky headers and overlays.
usage_rules.status_indicators: Use solid 8px w/h rounded-full circles for status. Green=Active, Red=Error, Amber=Warning, Gray=Inactive.

layout.grid_system: 12-column grid. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4' for dashboard widgets.
layout.sidebar: Fixed width 240px on desktop, collapsible on mobile.

cards.style: rounded-xl border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm

buttons.default: inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50

inputs.style: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 against background.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
Implement 'The Deep Void' theme by overriding CSS variables in index.css.
Ensure all text is legible with high contrast.
Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' for responsive layouts.
Status indicators must be clearly visible and color-coded (Green/Amber/Red).
Audit logs must use monospace font for data fields.
